about-simple-dynamic.mainStatement: IBS Academy is Kerala's leading professional accounting institute. For over two decades, we have been dedicated to shaping the next generation of finance professionals. Our mission is to equip students with a deep, practical understanding of key accounting concepts through an industry-relevant syllabus. We are proud to offer 100% placement assistance and direct pathways to globally recognized certifications, making us the gateway to your success in the financial world.
